## werk video

Generate, animate, transform, or upscale video

```text
werk video [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>
```

Subcommands: [`werk video generate`](cli-video.md#werk-video-generate), [`werk video animate`](cli-video.md#werk-video-animate), [`werk video transform`](cli-video.md#werk-video-transform), [`werk video upscale`](cli-video.md#werk-video-upscale).

## Option catalogue

Syntax ending in `...` accepts repeated values. List controls also
accept repeated occurrences of their flag. Boolean pairs inherit
when omitted; positive and negative flags conflict. Schema defaults,
units, types and task applicability are in the linked parameter table.

<a id="option-accelerator"></a>

### `--accelerator`

`--accelerator <ACCELERATOR>`

Requested accelerator, for example cpu, cuda, rocm, metal, or auto

<a id="option-allow-component-offload"></a>

### `--allow-component-offload`

`--allow-component-offload`

Permit component offload when GPU memory is insufficient and projected host RAM fits

<a id="option-allow-cpu-offload"></a>

### `--allow-cpu-offload`

`--allow-cpu-offload`

Permit model CPU offload when GPU memory is insufficient and the projected host-RAM requirement fits

<a id="option-allow-disk-offload"></a>

### `--allow-disk-offload`

`--allow-disk-offload`

Allow disk-backed model offloading; boolean [`routing.allow_disk_offload`](parameters-schema.md#routing-parameters).

<a id="option-allow-sequential-offload"></a>

### `--allow-sequential-offload`

`--allow-sequential-offload`

Permit slower sequential CPU offload when GPU memory is insufficient and projected host RAM fits

<a id="option-aspect-ratio"></a>

### `--aspect-ratio`

`--aspect-ratio <ASPECT_RATIO>`

Aspect ratio (runtime/model-defined control); string [`video.aspect_ratio`](parameters-schema.md#video-parameters).

<a id="option-attention-backend"></a>

### `--attention-backend`

`--attention-backend <ATTENTION_BACKEND>`

Requested attention implementation

<a id="option-batch-size"></a>

### `--batch-size`

`--batch-size <BATCH_SIZE>`

Videos processed per batch; integer [`video.batch_size`](parameters-schema.md#video-parameters).

<a id="option-bitrate"></a>

### `--bitrate`

`--bitrate <BITRATE>`

Bitrate (runtime/model-defined control); string [`video.bitrate`](parameters-schema.md#video-parameters).

<a id="option-camera-motion"></a>

### `--camera-motion`

`--camera-motion <CAMERA_MOTION>`

Camera motion (runtime/model-defined control); string [`video.camera_motion`](parameters-schema.md#video-parameters).

<a id="option-camera-strength"></a>
